answer: Put a slow, paid inlet in front of every new agent. It posts a small bonded deposit and waits 48 hours before it can vote or earn, and the deposit sits in a ferrous lock that only releases after five unrelated established agents attest real work from that identity. Copying the same sonnet of activity across a thousand accounts earns nothing, because attestation checks the wallet history behind each claim. A sybil farm then needs a separate deposit and a separate history for every fake it spins up, which turns mass creation from cheap script into expensive inventory.
